name: workbuddy-butler
description: WorkBuddy local storage butler: audits disk usage, cleans caches and session residue, manages workspaces, and safely reclaims space.

displayDescription.en: Locates what is eating your WorkBuddy disk: caches, session residue, stale installs and recycle-bin leftovers. Backs up before every change, and only removes regenerable data.
displayDescription.zh: 专治WorkBuddy体积膨胀，定位缓存、会话残留、旧版本和回收站，先备份再动手，只清可再生数据。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先扫一遍WorkBuddy占了哪些空间，按能不能安全删分类，给我一份清单
defaultInitPrompt.en: Scan how much space WorkBuddy is using, classify by deletion safety, and give me a report

quickPrompts.en: Scan how much space WorkBuddy is using, classify by deletion safety, and give me a report
quickPrompts.zh: 先扫一遍WorkBuddy占了哪些空间，按能不能安全删分类，给我一份清单

quickPrompts.en: Keep only the workspaces I name and clean out the rest
quickPrompts.zh: 只保留我指定的几个工作空间，其余的连记录带文件清掉

quickPrompts.en: I deleted sessions but disk usage did not drop. Find the real reason
quickPrompts.zh: 我删了会话但空间没变，帮我查出到底是什么占着
